{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-nks1","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ygp9: integer underflow in Ack bitmap encoding/decoding when bitmap has no trailing ones","description":"## Location
`rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` lines 273 and 323

## Root Cause
When an Ack has `bitmap=0` (no bits set), `trailing_ones() = 0`, so `n = WINDOW_SIZE - 0 = 64`. The encoding/decoding loop iterates `pos` from 0 to 63.

At `pos=63`, the expression `1u64 << (62 - pos)` computes `62usize - 63usize`, which is an unsigned integer underflow:
- **Debug builds**: panic (overflow)
- **Release builds**: wraps to `usize::MAX`, then `1u64 << usize::MAX` produces undefined/unexpected results

## Reproducer
```rust
// This panics in debug builds
let ack = Ack::new(0x78, 0, 0, false);
let mut buf = [0u8; 20];
ack.write_to(&mut buf).unwrap();
```

## Affected Code Paths
1. **write_to (line 273)**: `if self.bitmap & (1u64 << (62 - pos)) != 0` — loop iteration pos=63
2. **from_bytes_for (line 323)**: `bitmap |= 1u64 << (62 - i)` — loop iteration i=63 when n=64 from wire

## Trigger Scenario
A receiver has an empty window (received 0 fragments in window 0 for a particular rule). In `receive_ack_request`, `self.bitmaps[0] = 0`, so the ACK bitmap is all zeros. This ACK, when encoded via `write_to`, triggers the underflow.

## Fix Direction
Guard against pos/i >= 63 (since only bits 62..0 are meaningful per the struct comment: "Position 0 (FCN 62) is bit 62; position 62 (FCN 0 or All-1) is bit 0"). Bit 63 is unused. Alternative: bound n to `min(WINDOW_SIZE, 63)` or use `wrapping_sub` with masking.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:03:25.023329197Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:03:25.023329197Z"}
